chapter_title_en: The Fall of the Little Stone Emperor
chapter_seo_title: Little Stone Emperor's Tragic Fall and Legacy in World of Immortality Ch. 631
chapter_meta_description: The Little Stone Emperor reaches the pinnacle of power but his body shatters. He battles across time, then dies with a smile, leaving behind the Three Sovereign Mirror and a legacy of sorrow.
og_title: The Fallen Crown: Little Stone Emperor's Last Stand
og_description: A supreme being ascends to perfection only to crumble. The tragic death of the Little Stone Emperor reshapes the cosmos.
twitter_title: World of Immortality: Little Stone Emperor's Fall
twitter_description: He reached the peak, but perfection was his doom. The Little Stone Emperor's farewell will echo through the ages.
